attr.title: YTC
attr.desc: YTC (Your Tube Client) is a native, controller-driven YouTube client for handhelds. Browse, search, and watch YouTube with its own anonymous client.
attr.desc_md:
YTC (Your Tube Client) is a native, controller-driven YouTube client built for Linux handhelds and media centers. It talks to YouTube through its own anonymous Innertube client.

Features: search, Home/channel feeds, Community posts, playlists, Shorts, comments with replies, favorites, watch-later, history, SponsorBlock, quality/speed/volume controls, offline downloads, and casting to a linked device or Chromecast.
